operations.name: attach
operations.label: Attach Issue to Session
operations.description: Connect the calling Session to an Issue it is implementing, so the Issue's page lists it.

projectId.description: The Project the Issue belongs to; the caller's own Project by default.

operations.name: detach
operations.label: Detach Issue from Session
operations.description: Disconnect the calling Session from an Issue it is no longer working on.

projectId.description: The Project the Issue belongs to; the caller's own Project by default.

capabilities.reason: Reads and changes the Project's Issues as the signed-in person, and is the host of the Account this Plugin provides.
Asks GitHub for a sign-in code and for the token once the person has approved it (device flow).
